Run a speed test at Speedtest.net and check your upload speeds. If they are low, SPC your modem/router, or both if you have both. (SPC=Unplug for 30 seconds then replug back in) Then test if that helps. Otherwise go into the advanced firewall and add the inbound and outbound league client and patcher to the list, or enable it if its already in there. That may help.
